scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run build:api && bun run build:web
scripts.build:packages: bun run --cwd packages/contracts build && bun run --cwd packages/config build && bun run --cwd packages/ui-model build
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:web
scripts.test:unit: bun run build:packages && bun test packages apps/api
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:packages && bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
